'''Melford''' was a [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] [[City/Legends|city]] that was located on the northern coast of the [[Anai]] continent. Generally considered the prettiest city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with well manicured lawns and generally clean air, it was the site of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Melford Star Academy]]. Melford was also home to a large commerical and military [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] with a full complement of [[TIE/ln_space_superiority_starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and training craft.
